title: Structure panel click, right-click menu, and ` toggle
description:
The Structure nodes floating list now responds correctly: click a row to jump the PDF Viewer to that node’s page, and right-click the list for Select nodes / Adjust node size only (board menus no longer steal those right-clicks).

Also: press the ` key while your mouse is over the Map/Viewer workspace (and you are not typing in a text box) to enter or exit Structure Mode.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building + PDF Viewer on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync, open Structure Mode, click a list row and right-click the list to confirm.
changeLog: Fix Structure list click so it snaps the Viewer to the selected node.
Fix Structure list right-click menu (Select nodes / Adjust node size only).
Stop Map board context-menu capture from stealing clicks on the Structure float.
Add ` hotkey to toggle Structure Mode when the pointer is over the workspace.
